name: Honey.
source:
A primarily kinetic vn following Mackenzie; a 25 year old just trying to adjust to life post break-up alongside her best friend and roommate. Desperate for a job, but she seems to find the perfect position just when she needs it. The only catch is whatever's going on with her new boss.

[From [url=https://doughnutcleric.itch.io/honey]itch.io[/url]]
